options.text: I'm sorry for what I did.
I owe you an apology.
I came to say I was wrong.
What I did to your people was wrong, and I know it.
I apologize. Plainly and honestly.
No excuses. I did wrong by you.
I regret what happened between us.
I've come to own my mistakes.
You deserved better from me. I'm sorry.
Let me say it straight: I was in the wrong.
I wronged your side, and I'm here to admit it.
I keep thinking about what I did. I'm sorry for it.
There's no defending what I did. So I won't.
I wanted to apologize face to face.
I was reckless, and your people paid for it. I'm sorry.
Consider this an apology, late but honest.
My behavior was shameful. I'm here to say so.
I ask your pardon for what I've done.
I'll say it in front of the whole camp if that helps: I was wrong.
I've carried this a long way to say: forgive me.
I'm not leaving until you hear my apology properly.
Whatever it costs me to say it: I failed you, and I'm sorry.
Look me in the eye. I wronged you, and I'm ashamed of it.
I've rehearsed this apology for days. Every word is meant.
Punish me if you want, but hear me first: I am truly sorry.
On my honor, such as it is: I repent what I did to your people.
Sorry about all that business before.
Hey, no hard feelings about everything, right?
Can we just put the past behind us?
Let bygones be bygones, yeah?
I said sorry already. Doesn't that count?
Come on, everyone makes mistakes.
It wasn't personal, you know.
Water under the bridge, surely?
What would it take to make things right?
How do I fix this between us?
Tell me the price of forgiveness.
What do you want from me — goods, work, blood?
How does someone earn their way back with your side?
Name the amends. I'll pay them.
There must be some way to square this.
What would your officers accept as repayment?
If I wanted a clean slate, where would I start?
Walk me through how a debt like mine gets settled.
Is there a path back for someone like me?
What tribute would soften your people?
How deep is the hole I've dug, and what fills it?
Eight iron ingots, for the harm I caused. Take them.
I brought iron as amends. A full stack of eight.
Let this iron speak where my words failed — eight bars.
Iron for your smiths, offered in apology.
Take these eight ingots as a first payment on my debt.
My apology comes with iron this time. Eight pieces.
Three emeralds, offered to mend what I broke.
I brought emeralds as an apology. Three of them.
Take these three gems toward my debt.
Emeralds for the wronged. Three, and my regret with them.
A tribute of three emeralds, if your people will have it.
Let three green stones start paying for my mistakes.
Six emeralds. A real tribute for real harm.
I've saved six emeralds to put toward what I owe you.
This purse holds six gems. Take it as serious amends.
Six emeralds — the weight of my apology in stone.
For the damage done, six emeralds. Count them.
A diamond. The hardest thing I own, for the hardest debt I owe.
I brought a diamond. Let it answer for everything I can't undo.
One diamond, for the worst of what I did.
Take this diamond as blood-price. I know words won't do.
A diamond for your dead. It's not enough. Nothing is. But take it.
I know you'd rather kill me than hear me. Hear me anyway.
I betrayed you. I'm not here to deny it — I'm here to face it.
Is there anything left of my name here worth saving?
I'll wait here unarmed until someone accepts my apology.
Curse me if you need to. Then tell me how to begin repaying you.
What I did was unforgivable. I'm asking anyway.
You have every right to hate me. I came regardless.
If your side needs someone to blame, blame me to my face.
I don't ask for trust. I ask for a chance to earn the asking.
Even the guilty get to kneel. So here I am.
It won't happen again. You have my word.
I've changed. Give me the chance to prove it.
From today, your people have nothing to fear from me.
I swear off everything I did to earn your anger.
Watch me. My conduct will speak from here on.
I promise to be better to your side than I was.
The person who wronged you is done. I'm what's left.
Whatever I was to you before, I intend to be the opposite.
I killed your people. I want to answer for it.
There's blood on my hands. Your blood. I'm here about that.
I took lives from your side. I won't pretend otherwise.
Your dead are my doing. Tell me what I owe.
I've come to confess: I cut down your soldiers.
Some of your people didn't come home because of me. I know it.
I killed soldiers who wore your colors. I carry every one.
The graves on your side — some are mine to answer for.
I won't hide it. I've spilled your blood, and I regret it.
Name your dead, and I'll tell you which ones I owe you for.
I fought your people and some fell. I'm here to face their friends.
Whatever justice your side wants for its dead, I'm listening.
I hope there's no bad blood between us.
If I've ever stepped on your toes, I apologize.
Just making sure we're still square.
Are we good, you and I?
I try to stay in your people's good graces. How am I doing?
If I ever gave offense, it was never meant.
I value my name with your side. Tell me it still holds.
No grievances between us that I should know about?

negative: Words. Lighter than snow, and snow buries men. But we heard it. The ledger softens a hair.
Sorry doesn't fill graves. It fills silence. Fine — the silence needed filling.
An apology, spine straight, sober. That's more than most manage. One small mark in your favor.
neutral: Apology heard. The line moves on. Mostly it just moves.
Fine. Words logged in the general direction of forgiveness.
positive: Bah, you apologize like it's a funeral. We're past it, friend. Mostly past it.
Heard and shelved. Friends fight, friends dig, friends drink. Order varies.

negative: Statement received and appended to your file. Sentiment noted. Balance barely moved.
A verbal apology adjusts perception, not the record. Both matter. One just moved slightly.
Acknowledged. Contrition is a data point. Continue generating better ones.
neutral: Apology logged. No open grievances at this time.
Received. The file reflects a cooperative posture. Maintain it.
positive: Unnecessary but appreciated, friend. The ledger between us reads clean.
Apology accepted and honestly overkill. We're square.

negative: Words are wind. But some winds cool the tea. We felt this one. Slightly.
An apology walks in front of amends like a herald. We will see if the procession follows.
You water dry ground with speech. It takes much speech. This was a cup of it.
neutral: The words are received. The desert files them under weather.
Heard. A small stone moves from one side of the scale.
positive: Friend, your apology arrives to a table already set for you. Sit.
It is heard, and it was already forgiven. The tea did the forgiving yesterday.

negative: Loud sorrow, public sorrow. Takes a spine. The line respects spine even in enemies. Two marks.
You said it like a soldier reporting losses. Honest. Heavy. It counts.
That apology had weight. We weigh things here. It registered.
neutral: A full apology for a thin grievance. Take the credit anyway.
Strong words, properly meant. The line nods once.
positive: Friend, you apologize harder than we grudge. Stop before you owe us nothing at all.
All that ceremony for us? The stove's warm side is yours tonight.

negative: Formal contrition, delivered under scrutiny, on the record. This materially amends your file.
That was a complete statement of responsibility. Rare. Logged with weight.
Accountability without prompting. The board will note it. I already have.
neutral: Comprehensive apology, no deflection. Registered favorably.
Statement exceeds what the situation called for. Noted in your favor.
positive: At ease, friend. That level of formality is for tribunals. We're well past tribunal.
Filed under: unnecessary but honorable. The unit appreciates the gesture.

negative: You bare the throat to the blade and speak on. The desert respects what does not flinch. It moved us.
A deep bow in hostile shade. That is not nothing. The scale feels it.
Such words cost water. You paid them anyway. The camp saw.
neutral: A long apology for a short debt. The extra goes into the well.
Spoken like one who means to be believed. So we believe, a little more.
positive: Friend, you bring a feast of words to a table of friends. Eat with us instead.
The fire heard it all and warmed accordingly. Enough now. Sit.

negative: No hard feelings, he says. Feelings, no. Ledgers, yes. Ledgers are very hard.
The past is behind us, yes. Directly behind us. Breathing on our neck.
Bygones. Ha. We name our shovels after bygones.
neutral: Cheap words for a cheap peace. Fine. It holds until it doesn't.
Sure, sure. The past is past. It writes, though. It writes.
positive: Friend, you apologize for weather. Sit down, all is long settled.
Nothing to forgive that a drink didn't already dissolve.

negative: Putting it behind us is an amendment to records. Records take amends, not slogans.
That was an apology-shaped noise. The file recognizes only substance.
Informal remorse received. Formal debt unchanged. Do the arithmetic.
neutral: No open incident calls for this. Logged as courtesy.
Acknowledged. Sentimentality is not actionable, but it's not a violation either.
positive: We're square, friend. Have been since the last audit.
Nothing outstanding on my board. Carry on.

negative: You wave at the debt like a fly. It is not a fly. It is a well you must refill.
Light words float. Debts sink and wait at the bottom, patient as stones.
The bridge you speak of — the water under it is ours, and it remembers.
neutral: Peace offered lightly is accepted lightly. Balanced, as things should be.
The desert holds no grudge it wasn't paid to hold. We are fine, stranger.
positive: There is nothing behind us but road, friend. Walk forward with us.
The past drank its tea and left. Only friends at this fire now.

negative: Iron, sweat, or time. The ledger takes all three currencies. Words alone bounce.
Bring tribute the line can use, or take the penance work. Sorrow with weight, not just sound.
The count came from taking. It shrinks from giving. Iron, gems, labor. Pick.
neutral: Nothing owed, nothing needed. Keep your nose clean and your boots useful.
Your slate's shallow. A good deed or two clears it faster than a speech.
positive: Make right? Friend, you're in credit. Come drink your dividend.
The only debt between us is who buys next. It's you, but that's tradition.

negative: Restitution paths: material tribute, logged and receipted, or remediation work through an officer. Both amend the file.
The process exists. Tribute in goods, or labor under supervision. Sentiment optional, receipts mandatory.
Your file specifies the debit. Iron or emeralds move it fastest. Work moves it deepest.
neutral: No corrective action needed. Maintain current conduct.
The file is level. Keep it level — that's the whole procedure.
positive: Nothing to repair, friend. If you're feeling generous, the unit fund exists.
You're past making right and into making better. Different program, better coffee.

negative: The well you emptied refills three ways: gifts poured in, work carried out, and long, careful time.
Bring what the camp can drink, wear, or trade — or bend your back to our errands. The sand counts both.
Forgiveness here is bought like water in drought: dearly, gratefully, and in full view.
neutral: The scales sit level. Add nothing, take nothing, and they sing quietly.
Nothing is owed. Generosity now would simply be planting shade for later.
positive: Between friends the only debt is visits. Yours are paid in advance.
Make right? You are the example we point to, friend. Rest easy.

negative: Tribute counted and taken. The ledger loosens one buckle. One.
Metal where words were. Good. The line trusts weight. Debt shrinks, doesn't die.
Accepted into stores. The count comes down a step. Steps add up. Keep stepping.
neutral: Amends received for a small debt. Balance restored. Done.
Paid and squared. The pot even votes we forget it entirely.
positive: Friend, you're paying debts you don't have. We'll bank it against future stupidity. Yours or ours.
Tribute from a clean ledger? That's called a gift. Taken as one, twice thanked.

negative: Tribute received, weighed, receipted. Your debit shrinks accordingly. Continue this pattern.
Material amends logged against your infractions. The math improved. You still owe math.
Accepted per restitution protocol. The file thaws by one degree.
neutral: Restitution processed for a minor entry. Ledger clear.
Received and applied. Balance: acceptable.
positive: You're overpaying a paid account, friend. Entered as a donation with honors.
Applied to nothing, because nothing was owed. The fund thanks you.

negative: The first water returns to the well. It echoes at the bottom. More must follow, but this was heard.
Tribute taken with a level face. The debt bends. It does not yet break.
You pour, we measure. Today the measure was honest. The sand notes it.
neutral: A small mend for a small tear. The cloth holds. Finished.
Given and taken in balance. The matter closes like a tent flap.
positive: Friend, you bring payment to a fire that owes you supper. It becomes a gift and doubles.
The camp accepts, confused and touched. Your credit grows past your shadow.
